method: Executed static audit, official Khronos validator, saved blend/source-to-GLB count/bounds check and hash-bound independent-process geometry+NORMAL16 rebuild. Separately compared all source/delivery positions, indices/order, materials and transforms and measured normal precision; no art/GPU approval is implied.
observations: 19,052 triangles,3 materials/primitives and715,500 B; all positions, indices/order, material dictionaries and transforms exact to frozen r19.
Only NORMAL uses normalized signed SHORT with8-byte stride and declared KHR_mesh_quantization; no external decoder.
Fresh geometry reconstruction emits the exact frozen r19 float GLB, then packing reproduces this delivery GLB byte-for-byte.
Source blend and delivered GLB triangle counts and axis-converted bounds agree.
53 current exact-GLB images were generated; independent visual/factual/specification and target GPU/scene gates remain open.
